newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares hit new record, more gains possible.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares hit new record, more gains possible.

text.p: Danish share prices closed at a new record closing high for the second consecutive day on Monday fuelled by shipping and telecommunications paper, with dealers seeing more possible gains up front.
"Moeller shipping and Tele Danmark helped push the KFX to new heights. Rumours of BT interest in buying a stake in the Danish teleoperator persist despite denials," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 2.26 point up at 170.40 while the KFX June future rose 1.50 point to 170.20 with 312 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
A.P. Moeller's D/S 1912 closed 8,500 crowns up at 242,000 while the twin D/S Svendborg share climbed 9,000 crowns to finish the day at 347,000.
Tele Danmark put on another seven crowns to end at 346, continuing its upward run which started on BT rumours in London last Wednesday.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.369 billion crowns.
